OpenAI Brings AI Processing Inside India, Easing a Key Hurdle for Banks and Enterprises

OpenAI will now run AI requests from Indian business customers on servers inside India. Under the new arrangement, which it calls API inference residency, both the data a company submits and the computation that produces the answer stay within the country’s borders, rather than being routed to data centres overseas.

Removing a compliance roadblock

Many Indian organisations, particularly banks and other financial firms, have been cautious about deploying AI for serious work. Rules governing customer information often require it to be stored and handled domestically, which ruled out tools that processed requests abroad.
